## Core Verticals & Service Offerings

### 1. Astrology & Cosmic Guidance (`/astrology`)
- **Vedic Astrology (`/astrology/vedic`)**: Planetary alignment, Janam Kundli interpretation, Dasha analysis, career, marriage, health, and karmic remedies.
- **Kundli Analysis (`/astrology/kundli-analysis`)**: Deep birth chart scrutiny, dosha identification (Mangal Dosha, Kaal Sarp, Sade Sati), and customized gemstone/mantra remedies.
- **Tarot Card Reading (`/astrology/tarot`)**: Intuitive spreads for immediate clarity on love, relationship dynamics, financial decisions, and spiritual growth.
- **Numerology Consultations (`/astrology/numerology`)**: Life path numbers, destiny numbers, name vibration correction, and business name alignment.
- **Palm Reading (`/astrology/palm-reading`)**: Classical Chiromancy, Mounts and lines analysis for destiny and health indications.
- **Cowrie Reading (`/astrology/cowrie-reading`)**: Sacred ancient divination technique assessing primal energy patterns and immediate queries.

### 2. Holistic Healing & Spiritual Energy Work (`/healing`)
- **Reiki Energy Healing (`/healing/reiki`)**: Distance & in-person Usui Reiki channelled to restore chakra balance, relieve stress, reduce pain, and clear emotional blockages.
- **Mantra Healing & Vortex Therapy (`/healing/mantra`, `/myt/mantra-vortex`)**: Sound frequency therapy utilizing potent Sanskrit seed syllables to restructure mental, emotional, and energetic fields.
- **Tantra & Himalayan Tantra (`/healing/tantra`, `/myt/tantra`)**: High-order authentic spiritual Tantric disciplines focused on inner kundalini awakening, consciousness expansion, and removing intense negative energies.

### 3. Alternative Therapies & Body Balance (`/therapy`)
- **Acupressure Therapy (`/therapy/acupressure`)**: Meridian point stimulation to trigger self-healing mechanisms without needles.
- **Acupuncture (`/therapy/acupuncture`)**: Precise needle therapy restoring energetic qi circulation across physiological meridians.
- **Marma Therapy (`/therapy/marma`)**: Ancient Ayurvedic vital energy point stimulation for physical rehabilitation, stiffness, and trauma release.
- **Magnet Therapy (`/therapy/magnet`)**: Biomagnetic regulation to balance polarity, improve blood circulation, and relieve inflammation.
- **Auricular Therapy (`/therapy/auricular`)**: Specialized ear micro-system acupuncture/acupressure addressing neuromuscular pain and addictions.

### 4. M.Y.T. (Mantra, Yantra & Tantra) Wisdom (`/myt`)
- Comprehensive esoteric system connecting sound (Mantra), sacred geometry (Yantra), and energy alchemy (Tantra) for accelerated personal mastery.

### 5. Certified Academy & Training Courses (`/courses`)
- **Astrology Certification**: Vedic astrology, Tarot Masterclass, Numerology certification.
- **Healing Certification**: Usui Reiki (Level 1, 2, Master & Grandmaster), Lama Fera, Angel Blessing.
- **Therapy Training**: Acupressure diploma, Magnet therapy, Marma science.
- **Mind Reading & Manifestation**: Law of Attraction, Mid-Brain Activation, Subconscious Manifestation mastery.

### 6. Consecrated Energy Merchandise (`/merchandise`, `/product`)
- **Charged Gemstone & Rudraksha Bracelets**: Consecrated for chakra grounding, wealth attraction, evil eye protection, and spiritual focus.
